card.name: Linking word after drug in dosing section
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as 'is', 'for' or 'by' right after a drug name or patient group at the start of a Dosage and Administration section. They come just before the route, form or amount is stated.

modes.label: 'is' after dosage subject
modes.description: The verb 'is' following 'recommended dosage of DRUG' or a patient group, just before the dose.
modes.example: ( 2.1 ) The recommended dosage of ORSERDU<< is>> one 345 mg tablet taken

modes.label: 'by' or 'for' after drug name
modes.description: 'by' or 'for' after a drug name or vial, leading into a route or single-use statement.
modes.example: Each prefilled syringe is<< for>> single-dose only.
